theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) n) (x : Eucl P) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) n, ∃ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) n, ∀ y, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) y = (r ^ n)⁻¹ • (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) (r⁻¹ • (y - x))) → (∀ ω η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) n, (∀ y, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) y = (r ^ n)⁻¹ • (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) (r⁻¹ • (y - x))) → Y ω = X η) → ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), Y.massOn W ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((r ^ n)⁻¹) * X.massOn {y | r⁻¹ • (y - x) ∈ W}
